note: Standalone AGPL and GPL tools, per master brief Section 6.4. Each entry needs all four fields or the scan fails. Nothing linked into product code may appear here.

standalone.name: redis
standalone.justification: Cache, real-time backplane, rate limits and locks. Run as an unmodified server image; only the MIT StackExchange.Redis client is linked. Valkey is a drop-in fallback.

standalone.name: grafana
standalone.justification: Dashboards. Separate container, no product code links to it, dashboards are JSON in this repository.

standalone.name: loki
standalone.justification: Log storage. Separate container, reached over HTTP only.

standalone.name: tempo
standalone.justification: Trace storage. Separate container, reached over OTLP only.

standalone.name: clamav
standalone.justification: Upload scanning. Separate container, reached over its socket protocol.

standalone.name: ansible
standalone.justification: On-premises provisioning. A build tool, never shipped inside a product image.

standalone.name: renovate
standalone.justification: Dependency update pull requests. A continuous integration tool, never shipped.
